root_cause: Canonical content supervisor only invoked source-backed content orchestrator after a publish decision already existed. On fresh 2026-10-10 no decisions existed; daily posts remained PLANNED even while cron reported successful calls.
change: Use existing source-backed powerhouse-content-orchestrator once under the existing supervisor lease whenever any of four operational channel decisions is absent, then continue bounded generation and provider delivery. On in-flight child timeout never invoke it again in same tick.

production_truth.after_change: PR candidate only; no production-live claim without protected merge, Edge deploy, provider readback and measured outcome

evaluation.production_claim: unproven until protected merge, exact Edge version readback, live provider confirmation

prevention: Fresh-day no-decision state must trigger existing decision materializer before generation logic.
Protect each lane by its existing source, quality, identity, asset, uniqueness and provider gates.
Never promote a candidate, attempted post, or database tick to delivered outcome without independent receipt.
